cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 23 since November 2022. He spent about 30 years at Vulcan Materials, working as a senior sales representative, district sales manager and area sales manager. He holds a B.A. from Athens State University and an MBA from the University of North Alabama.
cands.gaps: We found no documented actions, bill sponsorships or stated positions from Mike Kirkland on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land conservation, immigration and H-1B, policing, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The sponsored-legislation list on his Ballotpedia page did not load with any content. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no news reports on controversies, no endorsements, and no documented foreign ties. We could not confirm the exact dates of his career at Vulcan Materials or whether he lived in Scottsboro throughout his adult life.
